core: PGC-1alpha and PPARA metabolic gene transcription
name: Clock-linked PGC-1alpha and PPARA metabolic transcription
rationale: Members are transcriptional programs controlling oxidative/fatty-acid metabolism (PGC-1alpha, PPARA, mitochondrial biogenesis) together with circadian BMAL1:CLOCK, ROR/REV-ERB and heme signaling, which separates it from the gluconeogenesis, adipogenesis, LXR and core-clock-protein confusables.

name: Nitric oxide synthase activation and NO-cGMP signaling
rationale: All members concern NOS activation, NO production and NO-cGMP signaling, whereas confusables cover downstream vascular smooth muscle tone, blood pressure, renal effects or eNOS trafficking.

qualifier: end processing and intron splicing, nuclear and mitochondrial
name: tRNA maturation by end processing and intron splicing
rationale: Members cover precursor tRNA 5'-leader and 3'-end processing, intron splicing, mitochondrial tRNA processing/modification and tRF biogenesis, unlike confusables centred on aminoacylation, pseudouridylation or tRNA import.

qualifier: glucocorticoid and aldosterone, with steroidogenic enzyme defects
name: Adrenal glucocorticoid and aldosterone biosynthesis and enzyme defects
rationale: Members are cortisol and aldosterone synthesis, its regulation and secretion, and CYP enzyme defects causing adrenal hyperplasia, distinguishing it from sex-steroid/pregnenolone confusables and from aldosterone-response/blood-pressure ones.

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to PI3K/AKT and RAS
name: ERBB, MET and ALK-family receptor tyrosine kinase signaling
rationale: Members are adaptor (GRB2, SHC1, GAB1, PI3K, PLCG1) signaling downstream of EGFR/ERBB2-4, MET/RON and ALK/LTK, distinguishing it from IGF1R/IRS, PTK6 and nuclear ERBB4 confusables.

name: Ephrin-mediated neuronal repulsion, fasciculation and synapse pruning
rationale: All members concern ephrin/EPH-driven repulsion shaping axons and synapses (growth cone collapse, fasciculation, pruning), unlike confusables with attractive DCC/L1/RAC1 signaling or semaphorin repulsion.

name: E2F-driven cell cycle genes and DNA replication initiation
rationale: Members combine E2F target/cell-cycle gene modules with replication initiation, unwinding and its regulation, whereas confusables emphasize either E2F/DREAM transcriptional control or pre-RC assembly and checkpoints alone.

qualifier: preinitiation complex and transcriptional regulator modules
name: RNA polymerase II transcription initiation and regulatory modules
rationale: Members concern Pol II preinitiation/initiation and gene modules of transcriptional regulators, distinguishing it from confusables focused on elongation, pausing and termination or on chromatin/ubiquitin modules.

qualifier: inner ear sensory hair cell specification
name: Ear morphogenesis and inner ear hair cell specification
rationale: Members are otic vesicle, cochlea, semicircular canal, middle ear and vestibulocochlear nerve formation plus auditory receptor cell fate, which separates it from cranial ganglion, olfactory and eye development confusables.

core: Adrenergic receptor signaling and epinephrine response
qualifier: alpha-2 inhibitory feedback on catecholamine and insulin secretion
name: Alpha-2 adrenergic inhibition of catecholamine and insulin secretion
rationale: Members concern adrenoceptor signaling, epinephrine response and alpha-2-mediated suppression of epinephrine, norepinephrine and insulin release, unlike Gi/z adenylate cyclase or cardiac inotropic/chronotropic confusables.

core: Endoderm specification and pancreatic progenitor lineages
name: Definitive endoderm specification and early pancreatic progenitor lineages
rationale: Members span definitive endoderm and foregut specification through multipotent, ductal and endocrine-mid pancreatic progenitors, separating it from late-stage endocrine/exocrine and gastrulation confusables.

name: Insulin signaling attenuation and adiponectin control of glucose import
rationale: Members regulate insulin receptor/IRS signaling (including attenuation), adiponectin signaling and glucose import/glycogen synthesis, unlike confusables centred on AKT2/IGF1R, glucagon or GLUT4 translocation.

qualifier: latency and host restriction of viral transcription
name: Cytomegalovirus infection, latency and host restriction
rationale: Members are HCMV early/late events, viral latency, host suppression of viral transcription and LRRFIP1-driven interferon, distinguishing it from the HIV replication and retroelement confusables.

name: RNA methylation and pseudouridylation with snoRNP assembly
rationale: Members modify rRNA, tRNA, snRNA and mRNA by methylation and pseudouridylation and include box C/D snoRNP assembly, unlike confusables on tRNA processing/aminoacylation, mitochondrial RNA, Cajal bodies or rRNA cleavage.

core: Gut motility and enteric nervous system development
name: Endothelin signaling in enteric nervous system and gut motility
rationale: Members combine endothelin receptor signaling, enteric neural crest development and gastric/intestinal motility and secretion, unlike vascular endothelin, RET/GDNF or urinary smooth muscle confusables.

core: Centrosome positioning and microtubule organizing center function
name: Centrosome positioning and microtubule nucleation and anchoring
rationale: Members concern centrosome location and cohesion, MTOC nucleation/anchoring and protein targeting to centrosome/cortex, unlike mitotic spindle, cilium/centriole duplication or tubulin modification confusables.

core: PTEN restraint of PI3K/AKT and IGF1R signaling
name: PTEN suppression of PI3K/AKT and its ceRNA regulation
rationale: Members concern PTEN loss, negative regulation of PI3K/AKT and IGF1R signaling and ceRNA/lncRNA control of PTEN, distinguishing it from PTEN stability/localization, inositol phosphate and RNA-binding-protein confusables.

core: Hindbrain and spinal cord neuron development
qualifier: motor neuron specification, patterning and migration
name: Hindbrain and spinal cord neuron specification and migration
rationale: Members cover neural tube D/V patterning, spinal motor/interneuron specification, hindbrain/brainstem development, branchiomotor and cranial nerves, unlike enteric, olfactory/cranial sensory, midbrain dopaminergic or neural plate confusables.

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to PI3K/AKT and ERK
name: MET/RON and ALK/LTK receptor tyrosine kinase signaling
rationale: Members are HGF-MET and MSP-RON signaling plus ALK/LTK and downstream PI3K/AKT/ERK, distinguishing it from ERBB, PTK6 and IGF1R/IRS confusables.

qualifier: strand invasion and repair DNA synthesis
name: Recombinational DNA repair by strand invasion and repair synthesis
rationale: Members concern strand invasion, SDSA, break-induced replication, sister chromatid exchange, cross-link repair and repair synthesis, unlike confusables on checkpoints, NHEJ or DSB sensing.

name: MHC class II exogenous peptide antigen presentation
rationale: All members concern processing and loading of exogenous peptides onto MHC class II (including in germinal center B cells), unlike MHC class I/cross-presentation or regulation-only confusables.

name: IL-12/IL-23 signaling and IL-17 Th17 responses
rationale: Members are IL-12/IL-23 signaling, IL-17 production and signaling, and Th17 commitment, unlike IL-10/IL-27, dectin/antifungal or IL-33/IL-36 confusables.

name: Vascular smooth muscle contraction-relaxation in arterial pressure control
rationale: Members regulate smooth muscle (mainly vascular) contraction and relaxation, cGMP effects and catecholamine/endothelin pressor control, unlike confusables on blood-pressure lowering, eNOS/guanylyl cyclase or adrenergic receptor signaling.

qualifier: immunoglobulin somatic diversification in B cells
name: Mismatch repair and immunoglobulin somatic diversification in B cells
rationale: Members are MutS/MutL mismatch repair and its defects plus somatic hypermutation, class switching, V(D)J recombination and B cell commitment, unlike TGFBR cancer mutant, APOBEC, T cell division or base excision repair confusables.

core: Insulin receptor signaling to glucose uptake and glycogen
name: Insulin receptor-AKT2 signaling to GLUT4 glucose uptake and glycogen
rationale: Members cover insulin receptor/IRS activation, AKT2, GLUT4 translocation, glucose import, glycogen synthesis and adiponectin, unlike glucagon/gluconeogenesis, glycogenolysis/glucokinase or insulin catabolism confusables.
